sections.title: How to read The Matchup

methods.label: Dated player and unit matchup
methods.summary: IceLines evaluates the submitted dressed units from reliability-adjusted player profiles, separately sealed pair/trio outcomes, opponent style, and bounded manager execution.

limitations: Player dimensions shrink toward 50 by games, minutes, shift volume, recency, and component coverage.
Exact shared deployment is affinity only; it contributes zero causal chemistry without a shift-aligned outcome residual.
Special-teams unit suitability is reported separately and excluded from the 5-on-5 matchup feature to prevent double counting.
Availability losses belong to the game edge's lineup features; The Matchup evaluates only the submitted dressed units.
Home last change is a bounded execution adjustment, not an automatic talent bonus.
